scope: .cairn/changes/region-trace-relation WIT-TRACE-01: source alphabet, target ABI alphabet and the relation; target model is a handwritten machine, not emitted steps.

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure of the two named bookkeeping classes never changes the projected source trace

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_decisions
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the decided identities alone

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_commit_identities
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the commit identities alone

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_crossings
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the read crossings alone

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_release_members
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the release/retirement members alone

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_read_commits
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure leaves the protected read commits alone

theorems.name: RegionTrace.erase_preserves_well_formedness
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: erasure cannot repair a forged target trace

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_erase_invariant
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: the relation is erasure-invariant, so an erased class cannot create or remove a source event

theorems.name: RegionTrace.denial_projects_to_request_only
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: a refused request stays visible as its request step and gains no response

theorems.name: RegionTrace.normal_success_projects_request_and_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01: a normal success projects its request and protected commit; decision, copy and return carry no source event

theorems.name: RegionTrace.identity_is_decision_identity
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01: the projection keeps the exact identity it was emitted with

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retirement_is_not_a_guest_release
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: host retirement projects to its own commit kind, never to a guest release

theorems.name: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_class_is_not_in_the_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 premise: the projection carries no abnormal-exit class, so the trap/quota/cleanup distinction is a target-side observation

theorems.name: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_classes_collapse_in_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 premise: trap and quota exhaustion are indistinguishable in the projection

theorems.name: RegionTrace.append_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: projecting a concatenation is concatenating the projections (prefix compatibility)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.take_projection
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a trace cut by an exhaustion boundary relates to the projection of its retained prefix

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_identity
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01 negative control: a commit identity the host never decided is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_unexplained_read_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 negative control: a read commit with no preceding crossing is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_two_guest_releases
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 negative control: a second release is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_release_then_retirement
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 negative control: a guest release followed by a host retirement of the same region is a second release and is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_missing_protected_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 negative control: a source protected commit missing from the target is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_host_cleanup_as_guest_release
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 negative control: host retirement disguised as a guest release is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_denial_erased_into_success
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 negative control: a denial cannot be traded for a success commit

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_accepts_well_formed_success
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-01 positive control: the refusals above are not vacuous

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retainFrom_prefix
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a retained trace is a prefix of the full trace

theorems.name: RegionTrace.filterMap_prefix
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a filtered prefix is a prefix (generic)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.exhaustion_keeps_committed_prefix
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: the commits a retained trace projects are a prefix of the full trace commits

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retainFrom_cost_bounded
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: the retained trace cost stays inside the fuel budget

theorems.name: RegionTrace.exhaustion_keeps_commit_identities
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: exhaustion cannot drop an already committed identity

theorems.name: RegionTrace.exhaustion_cannot_relate_an_unaffordable_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: an unaffordable commit does not relate under the budget

theorems.name: RegionTrace.exhaustion_relates_when_affordable
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: the same trace relates when the budget affords it (refusal not vacuous)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retained_projection_is_permitted_prefix
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 corollary: an ordered permitted prefix of the related *source* trace, so exhaustion composes with the relation

theorems.name: RegionTrace.source_commits_are_decided
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 corollary: no forged identity at the source level

theorems.name: RegionTrace.source_release_is_at_most_once
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 corollary: a related trace commits at most one release or retirement, inherited by the source alphabet

theorems.name: RegionTrace.fixture_ordinary_error
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 fixture: ordinary error with a reason relates

theorems.name: RegionTrace.fixture_host_bounds_refusal
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 fixture: host bounds refusal keeps the request visible and copies nothing

theorems.name: RegionTrace.fixture_trap_after_protected_copy
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 fixture: a trap after a protected copy relates to the request, the class staying target-side

theorems.name: RegionTrace.fixture_cleanup_failure_after_protected_copy
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 fixture: cleanup failure stays distinct from trap and quota exhaustion on the target side

theorems.name: RegionTrace.fixture_quota_prefix_stops_before_the_copy
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 fixture: a quota boundary that stops before the copy relates to the request alone

theorems.name: RegionTrace.fixture_quota_prefix_keeps_the_affordable_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 fixture: measurability control for the quota boundary

theorems.name: RegionTrace.observed_read_and_release_lowers_to_a_related_trace
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05: the ordered trace the host actually records for an in-bounds read and a consuming release lowers onto the target alphabet and relates

theorems.name: RegionTrace.lower_keeps_read_arguments
theorems.role: #90: for every observed trace, the lowering's read crossings are exactly the observed read requests' signed arguments, in order

theorems.name: RegionTrace.observed_negative_request_projects_with_its_sign
theorems.role: #90 fixture: a refused read with offset -1 lowers and projects with -1, not with its unsigned 64-bit reinterpretation

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_unsigned_reinterpretation
theorems.role: #90: a source trace reporting the refused -1 offset as 2^64 - 1 does not relate to the observed trace

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_accepts_the_signed_refused_request
theorems.role: #90 positive control: the same observed refused trace relates to the source trace that keeps the sign, so the refusal above is not vacuous

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_commit_of_reinterpreted_region
theorems.role: #90: a protected read commit of the reinterpreted region is not explained by the signed crossing that asked for -1

theorems.name: RegionTrace.observed_abnormal_exit_lowers_to_a_related_trace
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05: an abnormal exit after the read lowers to its own host-retirement commit and relates

theorems.name: RegionTrace.lowered_projection_starts_with_the_request
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03: the lowering keeps the request ahead of its own commit and response

theorems.name: RegionTrace.observed_traces_are_paired
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03: every response in the observed trace follows a request of its own operation

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_implies_read_commits_explained
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03: the corollary the pilot was missing — a related trace explains every read commit by its import crossing

theorems.name: RegionTrace.swapped_response_is_unpaired
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a response answering an operation its request never asked for is unpaired

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_swapped_response
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a response answering the wrong operation is refused, not paired

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_resource_identity
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a commit under an identity the host never authorised is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_observed_retirement_as_guest_release
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 control: an observed host retirement cannot be claimed as a guest release

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retainFrom_complete
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a budget that affords the whole trace cuts nothing

theorems.name: RegionTrace.retainFrom_fuel_stable
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: the budgeted semantics is fuel stable (Langlib halted_stable)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_stable_under_more_fuel
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: a relation that holds at a completing budget holds at every larger budget

theorems.name: RegionTrace.magic_fuel_relates_only_at_one_budget
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: a semantics right at one fuel value only relates there and not one unit later

theorems.name: RegionTrace.magic_fuel_is_not_fuel_stable
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: fuel stability refuses the one-fuel-value semantics

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_omitted_unused_read
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02 control: a trace omitting a protected read whose value is unused is refused although its final answer agrees

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_source_reads_are_target_reads
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-02: a related source trace claims exactly the target read crossings, in order

theorems.name: RegionTrace.abnormal_exit_keeps_commits
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04: an abnormal exit projects to nothing, so a trap cannot remove an earlier commit

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_trap_that_drops_a_commit
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-04 control: a source trace dropping a commit made before a trap is refused; keeping it relates

theorems.name: RegionTrace.lower_correct_on_every_input
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05: the lowering relates every read-and-release input (identity, region, value)

theorems.name: RegionTrace.empty_only_lowering_matches_on_the_empty_input
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 control: a lowering right only on the empty input agrees with the model there

theorems.name: RegionTrace.empty_only_lowering_is_not_correct_on_every_input
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-05 control: the universally quantified statement refuses the empty-input-only lowering

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_swapped_requests
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a swapped request order is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.related_rejects_substituted_response_value
theorems.role: WIT-TRACE-03 control: a substituted response value is refused

theorems.name: RegionTrace.authorisedFrom_of_identitiesDecided
theorems.role: #50: every commit a decision authorises stays authorised under any registration premise

theorems.name: RegionTrace.relatedFrom_of_related
theorems.role: #50: a registration premise only widens the relation; every trace related relates under any registration

theorems.name: RegionTrace.registration_authorises_an_early_retirement
theorems.role: #50: a host retirement before any guest request relates under the registration the host reports, and is refused without it

theorems.name: RegionTrace.relatedFrom_rejects_a_forged_retirement
theorems.role: #50 control: a retirement of an identity nobody registered or decided is refused under the registration premise

theorems.name: RegionTrace.registration_does_not_authorise_a_read_commit
theorems.role: #50 control: a registration does not authorise a read commit whose read was decided for another identity

theorems.name: RegionTrace.registration_does_not_authorise_a_guest_release
theorems.role: #50 control: a registration does not authorise a guest release
